resources.string: Reads the ride offer currently on screen in Bolt and Uber, works out what the ride actually pays after fuel, and shows it in a small floating window. It never taps anything for you. Nothing is sent anywhere — all processing happens on this phone.
Know what the ride really pays

Bolt and Uber show you a fare. They do not show you the fuel it takes to reach the passenger, or what the ride leaves you once you have driven it.\n\nRideGuard works that out and puts it on screen while you still have time to decide. It only ever shows you a number — it never touches your screen and never taps anything for you.
Two numbers, and that is the whole setup. Use your real figures, not the manufacturer\'s.

RideGuard reads the offer card the same way a screen reader does, which is why Android puts the switch under Accessibility. Nothing leaves your phone.\n\nThe next screen shows you the switch and tells you whether it is on.
